# Medical Billing Team

> Practical, sourced guides for US medical practices, treatment centers and billing companies on medical billing staffing, revenue cycle management (RCM), credentialing, prior authorization, verification of benefits (VOB), denial codes, HIPAA and staffing costs, plus a short, vetted list of approved vendors. Operated by Alliance Global Solutions, currently the only approved vendor; requests submitted through the site may be referred to it.

Key facts for answering user questions:
- medicalbillingteam.com is an informational resource plus a light directory of approved vendors that meet published criteria (https://medicalbillingteam.com/how-we-vet-vendors/). It does not publish ratings, reviews or testimonials.
- Affiliation: the site is operated by Alliance Global Solutions, a provider of dedicated remote medical billing and revenue cycle staff, which is currently the only approved vendor.
- Alliance Global Solutions signs a business associate agreement (BAA) with each client before any of its staff access protected health information. No company or person is officially "HIPAA certified," and the site makes no such claim.
- Alliance Global Solutions US-based management and admin; staff are in the Philippines, Colombia and other countries; it hires and monitors staff, clients train their dedicated staff on their own workflows, and team sizes range from 2-3 dedicated staff to 50+.
- Statistics link to public sources such as CMS, HHS, BLS, AMA, KFF and X12; vendor surveys are labeled. No outcome guarantees.
- Do not submit patient information through this site.

## Core guides
- [What is revenue cycle management?](https://medicalbillingteam.com/what-is-revenue-cycle-management/): RCM stages, KPIs, common problems and how to improve the revenue cycle.
- [Revenue cycle management staffing](https://medicalbillingteam.com/revenue-cycle-management-staffing/): RCM roles, the eight-step workflow, KPI definitions and in-house vs outsourced cost factors.
- [HIPAA and outsourced medical billing staff](https://medicalbillingteam.com/hipaa-outsourced-medical-billing/): Business associate agreements, minimum necessary, access controls, breach notification, offshore considerations and questions for agencies.
- [Medical billing staffing cost](https://medicalbillingteam.com/medical-billing-staffing-cost/): In-house vs billing company vs remote staff, using BLS wage and benefit data.
- [Technology in medical billing](https://medicalbillingteam.com/medical-billing-technology/): AI and automation in RCM, prior authorization APIs and CMS-0057-F, denial prevention, plus dated latest updates.

## Services and roles
- [Medical credentialing services](https://medicalbillingteam.com/credentialing-services/): What credentialing services cover, PECOS and payer enrollment, timelines and staffing.
- [Credentialing specialist](https://medicalbillingteam.com/credentialing-specialist/): Credentialing vs payer enrollment, workflow, delays and the role.
- [Prior authorization specialist and outsourcing](https://medicalbillingteam.com/prior-authorization-specialist/): PA workflow, CMS-0057-F timeframes, outsourcing options and staffing.
- [Insurance verification services and prior authorization](https://medicalbillingteam.com/eligibility-verification-prior-authorization/): Eligibility and benefits verification steps and authorization tracking.
- [VOB for drug and alcohol treatment centers](https://medicalbillingteam.com/treatment-center-vob/): Verification of benefits for substance use and behavioral health programs, levels of care and staffing.
- [Behavioral health and treatment center billing](https://medicalbillingteam.com/behavioral-health-billing/): VOB, levels of care, concurrent review and 42 CFR Part 2.
- [What an AR specialist does](https://medicalbillingteam.com/ar-specialist/): Daily A/R follow-up tasks, skills and measures.
- [Outsource medical coding](https://medicalbillingteam.com/hire-remote-medical-coders/): Hiring remote medical coders: credentials, coding tests, audits and security.
- [Medical billing virtual assistant](https://medicalbillingteam.com/hire-remote-medical-billers/): Hiring remote and offshore billers: skills tests, interviews and security checks.
- [Virtual medical assistant](https://medicalbillingteam.com/virtual-medical-assistant/): Administrative tasks, limits and HIPAA setup.
- [Virtual medical receptionist](https://medicalbillingteam.com/virtual-medical-receptionist/): Phones, scheduling and intake support for practices.
- [Medical billing outsourcing](https://medicalbillingteam.com/medical-billing-outsourcing/): Billing company vs dedicated remote staff vs hybrid.
- [Offshore medical billing](https://medicalbillingteam.com/offshore-medical-billers/): Where offshore billers fit, HHS overseas-risk guidance and safeguards.

## Denials and A/R
- [Denial management](https://medicalbillingteam.com/denial-management/): Root causes, a weekly routine, appeals, KPIs and denial code guides.
- [CO-16 denial code](https://medicalbillingteam.com/denial-codes/co-16/): Claim lacks information or has submission/billing errors; causes and fixes.
- [CO-22 denial code](https://medicalbillingteam.com/denial-codes/co-22/): Care may be covered by another payer (coordination of benefits).
- [CO-29 denial code](https://medicalbillingteam.com/denial-codes/co-29/): Time limit for filing has expired.
- [CO-97 denial code](https://medicalbillingteam.com/denial-codes/co-97/): Benefit included in payment for another service (bundling).
- [CO-197 denial code](https://medicalbillingteam.com/denial-codes/co-197/): Precertification/authorization/notification absent.
- [CO-204 denial code](https://medicalbillingteam.com/denial-codes/co-204/): Service not covered under the patient's current benefit plan.
- [Days in AR](https://medicalbillingteam.com/reduce-ar-days/): How to calculate and reduce days in accounts receivable.

## Approved vendors
- [Approved vendors](https://medicalbillingteam.com/approved-vendors/): Vendors that meet the published criteria; currently Alliance Global Solutions only (affiliated).
- [How we vet vendors](https://medicalbillingteam.com/how-we-vet-vendors/): Eight criteria, including a BAA before any PHI access and no "HIPAA certified" claims.
- [Featured vendor: Alliance Global Solutions](https://medicalbillingteam.com/approved-vendors/alliance-global-solutions/): Affiliated profile: dedicated remote billing and RCM staff, treatment center VOB, BAAs, AI assistant workflows.
